name: Superconduct Blessing: Electric Surge
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Cryo Dice and 2 Electro Dice.
After you trigger a Superconduct reaction: The enemy character with the highest HP receives 1 Piercing DMG. (3 times per Round)
